title: Kites Above the Clover
description: Climb from clover into kite-filled wind, then cross the exposed ridge above the valley. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute stage

rooms.name: Clover beneath the strings
rooms.lesson: Keep your first jumps low. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The windy hillside
rooms.lesson: Rise with the hillside · brake into the wind. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The kite field
rooms.lesson: Ride the thermal · leave it sideways. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The high ridge
rooms.lesson: Reverse once around the rocky shoulder. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.

rooms.name: The exposed hilltop
rooms.lesson: Cross the last wind-cut gaps. Pass behind a turning sail; the gold edge is dangerous.
